events.title: Release Date Announcement, MC Sprites & Progress Update
events.summary: Greeting, darlings!Devlogs scare me.No, seriously, they terrify me. I'm normally an anxious, self-conscious mess so I overthink every single word I put out for you to see and it took me almost 4 hours to write this. Ridiculous, isn't it? That is why you get so little information on what we're doing. But I'll try to do better, so please be patient with me. For those of you interested just in a summary:Release date has been set to 29.
